0022600016.text: The Boston Celtics (3-1) host the Chicago Bulls (1-3) in this East Group C Emirates NBA Cup game, Boston's fifth of the season. The Celtics are 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East, riding a three-game winning streak with a perfect 3-0 home record, while the Bulls are 11th in the East, 2 games back in the Central, and have lost two straight. Boston is without Devin Carter (illness), and Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring), Patrick Williams (groin soreness) and Tobe Awaka (ankle), and the teams' last meeting on October 26 in Boston ended with the Celtics winning 134-99, giving Boston a 1-0 lead in the 2026-27 season series after going 2-1 against Chicago in 2025-26.
